meta.title: Counter offer after an accepted one

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen with Vendor A's existing bid.
Open the buyer comparison grid where the counter-offer control is available.
Send the first counter offer, changing Vendor A's price to 90 with the required remark.
Verify that the first counter offer was initiated for Vendor A.
Have Vendor A accept the pending counter offer through the supplier portal.
Verify on the buyer side that Vendor A's counter offer is marked accepted.

args.because: Accepted bid exists. You cannot perform this action.

steps.note: Attempt a second counter offer after acceptance and require Procol's stated refusal.
